app.name: HuiLu
app.tagline: Local meeting notes: record audio / screen → transcribe → AI summary

popup.title: Record
popup.sourceDesktopHint: A picker will open. Tick “Share audio” to record sound
popup.micPreviewFailed: Could not open this microphone for a preview. Check that it is connected
popup.micNeedsPermission: Microphone access is needed the first time
popup.micDenied: Microphone access was blocked. Allow it in the browser's site settings and try again
popup.controlsInSidePanel: Pause, resume and stop from the floating recording panel on the page
popup.panelUnavailable: This page does not allow the floating recording panel (e.g. chrome:// pages). You can control the recording here

sidepanel.savedDetail: "{{title}}" · {{duration}}. Find and preview it in History
sidepanel.endedBySource: The tab was closed or sharing stopped, so the recording ended
sidepanel.endedByError: The recording did not finish cleanly; the end or a track may be missing. Everything that was written is kept
sidepanel.notSaved: The recording could not be saved: {{error}}
sidepanel.hint: Click “Start recording” in the popup, or press Alt+Shift+R to record the current tab

history.localNote: Recordings are first kept in the browser's internal storage and do not need a transcription service or data folder. Once a transcription service is set up, finished recordings are transcribed, summarized and saved to the data folder automatically. Nothing here deletes a recording.
history.notTranscribedNoService: Not transcribed: no transcription service is set up yet. You can still preview or download the recording
history.unfinishedHint: This recording was interrupted. Recover it from "Unfinished recordings" in the popup; you can preview what was recorded first
history.noTranscriptAudio: No transcription audio was recorded, so this cannot be transcribed. The video was kept and can be previewed or downloaded

processing.transcriptOnly: No LLM service is set up: only the transcript will be created. You can add the summary after setting one up
processing.waitingFolder: The transcript and summary are ready and kept in browser storage. They will be saved once the data folder is authorized
processing.done: Done. Saved to “{{folder}}” in the data folder

summarySkipped.notConfigured: No summary: no LLM service is set up
summarySkipped.unknownProvider: No summary: the selected LLM provider is not recognized. Choose it again in settings
summarySkipped.hostPermission: No summary: HuiLu is not allowed to reach the LLM address. Save it again in settings
summarySkipped.emptyTranscript: No summary: no speech was recognized

notQueued.noAudio: No transcription audio was recorded, so this cannot be transcribed
notQueued.notConfigured: No transcription service is set up
notQueued.meetingNotFound: The meeting information for this recording is missing
notQueued.notProcessing: This recording does not need processing

error.transcriptionNotConfigured: No transcription service is set up
error.unknownProvider: The selected provider is not recognized. Choose it again in settings
error.hostPermission: HuiLu is not allowed to reach this address. Save it again in settings to grant access
error.sourceDataUnavailable: Completed meeting data is unavailable. Authorize the original folder or check meeting.json and transcript.json

folder.pathNote: For security reasons the browser only exposes the folder name, not its full path.
folder.persistHint: After a browser restart you will be asked once more; choose "Allow on every visit" and you will not be asked again.
folder.reloadHint: Updating or reloading the extension may require re-authorization.
folder.suggestion: We suggest creating a folder named HuiLu in Documents and choosing it; every meeting is saved as a subfolder.

settings.diarizationNo: No speaker diarization (the transcript shows a single speaker; you can label speakers manually)
settings.maxFile: Up to {{size}} per file; larger files are split automatically
settings.hostPermissionDenied: Permission to access {{origin}} is required to connect

paraformer.name: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio Paraformer (default)
paraformer.access: Model Studio API; audio is uploaded as a temporary file (valid for 48 hours)
paraformer.free: Time-limited quota for new users (see console)

groq.name: Groq Whisper large-v3-turbo
groq.free: ≈ 8 hours of audio per day; ≤ 25MB per file (split automatically)

transfer.title: Import / export settings
transfer.includeKeys: Include API keys in the export
transfer.keysWarning: Keep settings files that contain API keys private; do not share them.

settings.keyCleared: The service address changed, so the previous key was cleared. Enter the key for the new provider

onboarding.title: Welcome to HuiLu
onboarding.intro: Three quick steps, about a minute. You can change everything later in Settings.
onboarding.step1Desc: Recordings, transcripts and summaries are saved as plain files in this folder and survive uninstalling the extension.
onboarding.step2Desc: Turns recordings into timestamped transcripts. Paraformer (Alibaba Cloud Model Studio) is recommended: reachable from mainland China and supports speaker diarization.
onboarding.step3Desc: Writes meeting summaries from transcripts. Any OpenAI-compatible API works, including a local Ollama.
onboarding.doneDesc: Click the HuiLu icon in the toolbar to start recording a meeting.

warning.micUnavailable: The microphone could not be opened; this recording has no microphone audio
warning.noAudio: No audio is being captured; this recording cannot be transcribed
warning.lowStorage: Less than one hour of storage left

error.busy: A recording is already in progress
error.noAudio: Nothing to record: the source has no audio and the microphone is off or unavailable
error.storage: Not enough storage to start recording
error.permission: Cannot capture this page: permission denied, or the page cannot be recorded (e.g. chrome:// pages)
error.captureFailed: Could not open the source picker: {{detail}}
error.systemPermission: The system does not allow Chrome to record the screen. Allow Google Chrome in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen & System Audio Recording, restart Chrome and try again
error.windowClosed: The recording window was closed, so the recording stopped. What was recorded can be recovered from "Unfinished recordings"

unfinished.title: Unfinished recordings found
unfinished.body: A recording was interrupted (e.g. the browser crashed). What was recorded is still here
unfinished.confirmDiscard: Discard it? The recorded content will be deleted
unfinished.nothingToRecover: “{{title}}” had nothing to recover and was removed

permissions.micBody: HuiLu records in the background and cannot show the permission prompt there. Click the button below and choose “Allow” in the browser prompt.
permissions.micGranted: Done. You can close this page and start recording from the popup.

readiness.folderPrompt: The data folder needs to be re-authorized
readiness.folderDenied: Access to the data folder was denied
readiness.folderNote: Recording still works: it is kept in the browser and written to the folder once authorized
readiness.apiNote: You can still record and play back; transcripts and summaries need a service

field.clientHeadersHint: When on, the extension adds User-Agent: claude-cli/2.1.88 (external, cli) and x-app: cli only to its own requests to open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4/ (a Chrome declarativeNetRequest rule, without the API key). Web pages and other providers are not affected. This imitates a coding tool's headers as an experiment; it is not an integration supported by Zhipu.

preset.zhipuHint: The standard API is billed per use or against resource packs; it does not use GLM Coding Plan quota. Enter the model name from Zhipu's docs.
preset.glmCodingPlanHint: Experimental: uses the Coding Plan endpoint; enter the key and model name from your plan page. Zhipu limits plan quota to officially supported tools, HuiLu is not on that list, and whether the service accepts these requests is unverified. A successful request does not prove plan quota was used; check Zhipu's billing details. Errors never fall back to the standard API; errors such as 1113 may mean insufficient balance or that the plan was not recognized.
preset.ollamaHint: Start Ollama with OLLAMA_ORIGINS=chrome-extension://* or it will reject requests from the extension.

error.invalidConfig: The configuration is incomplete or invalid
error.unauthorized: The API key is invalid or expired
error.forbidden: Access denied: check that the service is enabled for your account and the key’s scope
error.notFound: Endpoint not found: check the Base URL
error.modelNotFound: The provider has no such model. Available models include
error.badRequest: Request rejected: check the model name and other parameters
error.rateLimited: Too many requests or a temporary provider usage limit was hit; try again later
error.quotaExceeded: The provider account is out of balance or credits, in arrears, or its plan / spend limit is used up, so waiting will not help. Check the provider account and API settings, or switch to another service in Settings, then retry manually
error.server: The provider is temporarily unavailable; try again later
error.network: Could not connect: check your network, proxy or Base URL
error.timeout: Connection timed out: check your network or proxy
error.badResponse: Unrecognized response: check that the Base URL points to the right API
error.fileTooLarge: The audio file exceeds the provider's single-file limit
error.taskFailed: The provider could not finish the job

recorderWindow.choosing: Choose the window or screen to record in the picker…
recorderWindow.keepOpen: This window captures the window / screen. Keep it minimized, but do not close it or the recording stops. It closes itself when the recording ends.
recorderWindow.recording: Recording. The timer and pause / stop controls are in the floating recording panel on the page.

panel.title: Recording panel
panel.hint: The panel floats over the page; drag or collapse it. After closing, reopen it from the extension icon. When recording a tab with video, the expanded panel is captured in the video.

result.unavailableHint: Check access to the original data folder, then refresh. Restore damaged files from a backup. Your local files have been kept.
result.title: Meeting title
result.autoSaveHint: Press Enter or leave the field to save automatically
result.readOnly: Available for playback. Save to your data folder to enable editing.

save.error: Could not save. Check folder access and try again.
save.conflict: Changed in another page. Refresh before editing again.
save.empty: The title and speaker names cannot be empty.

result.mergeHint: Both speakers will appear under the selected name. The original recording and text are kept.
result.noTranscript: There is no transcript yet. Configure transcription in settings, then start it from History. Your recording is still available to play.
result.noSummary: There is no guide yet. Configure a language model, then create a summary from History.
result.damagedText: Some text files could not be read. Restore them from a backup and refresh. Available media can still be played.
result.playbackError: Could not play this media. Check folder access, or download the original file to play it on your device.
result.noSummaryExport: Available after a summary is created
result.mp4Unavailable: No MP4 video is available. Download the original format.
result.aacUnavailable: This browser cannot encode M4A. Download the original audio instead.
result.exportError: Export failed. Check folder access, or download the original media.

library.note: Recordings and meeting files stay on your device.
library.folderUnavailable: The data folder is unavailable. Your list has been kept. Restore access to open these meetings.
library.loadError: Could not load meetings. Refresh to try again.
library.duplicate: Duplicate meeting ID. Check the original data folder.
library.damaged: This record could not be read. Original files have been kept.
library.accessNeeded: Restore access to the original data folder
